newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGB futures end up on scepticism about land plan.
newsitem.headline: JGB futures end up on scepticism about land plan.

text.p: Key June Japanese government bond (JGB) futures ended Monday's Tokyo session higher in thin, dealer-led trade.
The key contract rose as high as 125.95 shortly after the open due to scepticism about the effectiveness of a reported government plan to boost land liquidity.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Monday the government plans to buy 380 billion yen worth of collateralised property previously owned by failed housing loan firms and other debt-ridden financial institutions in 1997/98 as part of measures to boost liquidity in Japan's property market.
